        Solver solver = new Solver();
        solver.solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class Solver {
        private int addWords(String text, int current) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(text, "_");
            return current + st.countTokens();
        }

        public void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            String s = in.next();
            int winpars = 0;
            int longest = 0;

            s = s.replaceAll("_+", "_");
            n = s.length();

            int i = 0;
            while (i < n) {
                if (s.charAt(i) == '(') {
                    int j = i;
                    while (j < n && s.charAt(j++) != ')') {
                        if (s.charAt(j) == ')') {
                            winpars = addWords(s.substring(i + 1, j), winpars);
                            i = j;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    i++;
                }
            }

            while (s.indexOf('(') != -1 || s.indexOf(')') != -1) {
                s = s.replaceAll("\\([^\\(]*\\)", "_");
            }

            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(s, "_");
            while (st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String temp = st.nextToken();
                if (temp.length() > longest) {
                    longest = temp.length();
                }
            }

            out.println(longest + " " + winpars);
        }
    }

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        new Solver().solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class Solver {
        public void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            String s = in.next();
            int winpars = 0, longest = 0;

            s = s.replaceAll("_+", "_");
            n = s.length();

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
                if (s.charAt(i) == '(') {
                    int j = i;
                    while (j < n && s.charAt(j++) != ')') {
                        if (s.charAt(j) == ')') {
                            int count = 0;
                            boolean inToken = false;
                            for (int k = i + 1; k < j; k++) {
                                if (s.charAt(k) == '_') {
                                    inToken = false;
                                } else if (!inToken) {
                                    inToken = true;
                                    count++;
                                }
                            }
                            winpars += count;
                            i = j;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    i++;
                }
            }

            while (s.indexOf('(') != -1 || s.indexOf(')') != -1) {
                s = Pattern.compile("\\([^\\(]*\\)").matcher(s).replaceAll("_");
            }

            StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer(s, "_");
            while (tok.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String temp = tok.nextToken();
                if (temp.length() > longest) {
                    longest = temp.length();
                }
            }

            out.println(longest + " " + winpars);
        }
    }
}
